description: camera.controller lists the sites whose own cameras drive the one camera; the Walk switch hands over to the first that walks where the camera is (moonbase: the sector's player only inside its rooms), else the engine's camera walks from there, never jumping (2026-10-27); Fly hands it back to Sol's flight.

steps.label: out of the facility, the engine's camera walks
Walk goes on from where the camera is

steps.expr: (() => { const s = entities.sites.find(s => s.id === 'sector'); entities.setWorldView(entities.siteFrame(s).toWorld({ pos: s.world.app.player.cfg.start.pos, fwd: [0, 0, -1], up: [0, 1, 0], fov: 1 })); return true; })()

steps.label: in its rooms, Walk hands the camera to the sector's player
only the controller's camera is unlocked
the player takes over where the camera is

steps.note: face a screen 1.5 m away, walking
steps.expr: (() => { const s = entities.sites.find(s => s.id === 'sector'), A = s.world.app, g = A.interaction.guis()[0], c = g.center(), p = A.player.pos, d = Math.hypot(p[0] - c[0], p[2] - c[2]) || 1, e = [c[0] + (p[0] - c[0]) / d * 1.5, c[1], c[2] + (p[2] - c[2]) / d * 1.5], fwd = [(c[0] - e[0]) / 1.5, 0, (c[2] - e[2]) / 1.5]; entities.setWorldView(entities.siteFrame(s).toWorld({ pos: e, fwd, up: [0, 1, 0], fov: 1 })); return g.name || true; })()

steps.label: still the sector player at its screen
the screen in front takes the cursor (the GUI terminals work)
Fly hands it back to Sol
